  if (dataSource.getJndi() != null && !dataSource.getJndi().startsWith("java:comp/env/jdbc/")) {

    throw new SpagoBIRestServiceException(msgBuilder.getMessage("sbi.datasource.jndi"), buildLocaleFromSession(), new Throwable());
